process.name: Enrich and Post Bank Remittance Transactions

notes: Bank enrichment and remittance posting only; downstream MOA context is adjacent and is not a Bank workflow step. Upstream bot / UiPath Action Center intake is adjacent and is not a Bank workflow step.

interaction_surfaces on each interaction, reconciliation, and transfer node enumerate the kinds of systems the step touches with their integration class and a controlled role from {read, write, source, target, unknown}. Role 'source'/'target' mark the two ends of a write/transfer seam; role 'unknown' is used where the frozen source does not establish the transfer mode (e.g. a drafted outbound email whose send is left unsent / out of scope). Surfaces carry no trigger, precedence, or consultation-condition detail; that hidden logic belongs to Layer 2. The lists are retained deliberately so the active system reads and writes each step requires remain visible for interface design.

nodes.title: Open Assigned Transaction Queue
nodes.detail: In Bank portal open Transaction History / 'Transactions Assigned To Me', set Transaction Value Date and Workflow Status filters, and handle the 'Maximum result size of 5000 exceeded' warning by narrowing the date range to a single day.

nodes.title: Reconcile Against Assignment Workbook
nodes.detail: Open the exported assignment workbook and SummaryReport in Excel, reformat Payment / Serial Number from scientific notation to Number, and align highlighted rows against the live Bank queue; review rows marked Unprocessed for follow-up.

nodes.title: Select Working Row Block
nodes.detail: Filter Transaction History by Entity Name and select the contiguous block of related entity rows (watching the VIEW/ASSIGN/WORKFLOW/EXPORT footer counters) to establish the working batch for item-level handling.

nodes.title: Assign Batch To Processor
nodes.detail: Open Select a user, filter the user list, select the current user, and click ASSIGN so the selected rows route to the processor's workflow (write to Bank); confirm the 'N transactions were successfully assigned' toast, then export the assigned queue to CSV for offline review (a Bank->CSV export transfer seam: source Bank, target the offline CSV file).

nodes.title: Open Transaction Details
nodes.detail: Open Transaction Details for the selected record and review Payment Amount, Invoice Allocation, Difference, and Status Enrichment Required, plus the lower wire fields (Originator to Beneficiary, Wire Type, Beneficiary, Method of Payment).

nodes.title: Confirm Invoice In Acme
nodes.detail: Run New Search in Invoicing app by Customer ID or Invoice#, confirm the matching invoice row, and resolve payer aliases via Company records app or Collections workbench when validation errors occur. Where an ERP receipt check is needed, verify the matching ERP (receipts) Receipts record for Receipt Method, amount, State Cleared, and the applied invoice/amount lines (validation read only).

nodes.title: Cross-Check Supporting Evidence
nodes.detail: Confirm the payment against the Bank statement report highlighted credit line, Outlook payment-advice emails and PDFs, and the per-customer Dashboard / assignment workbook where the invoice split is not directly stated. Bot-generated bank-statement output and UiPath Action Center remittance tasks are consulted as supporting evidence only.

nodes.title: Check Bulk Upload Needed
nodes.detail: Decide whether the payment is a one-to-many remittance best populated via the prepared UploadTemplate upload file, or a manual invoice-row entry. Cognition on evidence already surfaced upstream; no direct system read at this node.
nodes.condition: Is a one-to-many UploadTemplate upload the appropriate method?

nodes.title: Upload Remittance Template
nodes.detail: Stage the invoice rows in the prepared UploadTemplate file (pasting from Dashboard exports, remittance CSVs, or PDF check stubs via Paste Special > Text and Convert Text to Columns, preserving full invoice numbers), then load the invoice rows into the Bank remittance editor and confirm the 'N record(s) successfully uploaded. You must click the Save button to retain uploaded data' toast.

nodes.title: Check Allocation Balanced
nodes.detail: Decide whether the uploaded rows allocate to the payment amount (Difference 0.00) or over/under-allocate requiring correction. Legible binary on the Bank Difference value surfaced upstream.
nodes.condition: Does the uploaded remittance balance to zero difference?

nodes.title: Enter Invoice Rows
nodes.detail: In the Bank remittance editor (New Rows / ADD / DELETE / DISASSOCIATE ADVICES) enter each confirmed invoice number and amount, building one-to-one, one-to-many, or many-to-one allocations until Invoice Allocation approaches the Payment Amount.

nodes.title: Reconcile Remaining Difference
nodes.detail: Iteratively add, adjust, or remove invoice rows in the Bank grid (write) using Acme and the balance report (read) until Difference reaches 0.00, adding a Finance charge line where a small bank-charge residual must be absorbed, or resetting an over-applied allocation back to the payment amount (self-loop e-022; the stop threshold that ends the iteration is not established in the frozen source). The correction resolves to one of several materially distinct dispositions, each an explicit route out of this node: resolved to zero (e-014 -> n-013); partial match with the matchable portion allocated and the residual documented (e-019 -> n-013, the completion-with-residual path); an unidentified item moved to Reviewed workflow status (e-020 -> n-019); or, where no invoice match can be confirmed, a customer-facing remittance inquiry drafted from the Notepad template with a Snipping Tool credit-line capture and addressed to the customer Accounts Payable mailbox with the internal Payments mailbox in Cc, item left Reviewed / On account / Sent email (e-021 -> n-020). The outbound email is drafted; its send is left unsent / out of scope, so the outbound transfer mode is unknown. Which disposition applies, the confidence threshold, and the eligibility boundary are not established here; they are deferred to dm-correction-unresolved and What We Still Need to Know.

nodes.title: Save Remittance Update
nodes.detail: Click Save and confirm the 'Save Successful / Reference items were successfully updated' toast and the remittance status change to Enrichment Complete.

nodes.title: Confirm Mark Complete
nodes.detail: Click MARK COMPLETE, confirm YES in the modal, and wait for the record to reload in Enrichment Complete status with 0 open advices.

nodes.title: Record Enrichment Complete (0 open advices)
nodes.detail: The record reloads in Enrichment Complete status with 0 open advices, the recorded terminal state of the enrichment. Contradictory: observations record records reaching this completion state without full invoice backing or with an unresolved / documented residual (e.g. 824.00 and 8,395.01 completed with no remittance rows; partial 918.60 -> 612.40 and SYN Osprey Holdings 52,144.36 -> 34,149.00; a 12,846.39 item completed no-rows after an over-allocation revert; SYN Larkspur Holdings 1,688.33 completed to a 'DO NOT USE' account), which conflicts with the stated 'Difference 0.00 / invoice-backed / 0 open advices' success criterion. Preserved, not resolved.

nodes.title: Verify Completed Record
nodes.detail: Return to Transaction History (or reopen the record) to confirm the transaction shows Enrichment Complete and the invoice-backed remittance rows, cross-checking Workflow & Notes and the Open Advices count (read); this step also carries two workflow write seams to Bank: assign the completed record to the responsible processor (Workflow & Notes > Select a user) and batch-set completed rows to Reviewed via WORKFLOW > Update Workflow Statuses (both established portal writes). Review Receivables > Reports > Assigned-to Summary for queue oversight.

nodes.title: Classify Assignment Tracker Row
nodes.detail: In the assignment workbook mark the matching row 'completed' and set the payment-type classification in the column U/V/W dropdown (One-to-One / One-to-Many / Many-to-One / Short Payments / Summarized Invoices / Summarized Invoice exact / E-mail / Invoicing app / Bank statement / On account / Sent email / Unidentified), configured via Data Validation lists sourced from Sheet1; correct entries that trigger the data-validation restriction error, aligning rows against the exported CSV.

nodes.title: Item Left In Reviewed / Unidentified Status
nodes.detail: An unidentified item is moved to Reviewed workflow status and left, rather than proceeding to Enrichment Complete via Mark Complete. This is a recorded off-spine disposition, not a completed state. Whether, when, and how such an item is later resolved (matched/posted, escalated, or handed off downstream) is not established in the frozen source: closure, eligibility boundary, confidence threshold, and any Bank->MOA hand-off are More information required. No onward edge is asserted.

nodes.title: Remittance Inquiry Drafted (Reviewed / On account / Sent email)
nodes.detail: Where no invoice match can be confirmed, a customer-facing remittance inquiry is drafted and the item is left in Reviewed / On account / Sent email status, rather than proceeding to Enrichment Complete via Mark Complete. This is a recorded off-spine disposition, not a completed state. The drafted email's send is left unsent / out of scope. Whether, when, and how the item is later resolved or handed off downstream (e.g. money-on-account research) is not established: closure, eligibility boundary, and any Bank->MOA hand-off are More information required. No onward edge is asserted.

edges.label: Correction reconciles the remainder to Difference 0.00; the record proceeds to Save. The threshold that judges the allocation confident enough to complete is not established (More information required); deferred to dm-correction-unresolved.

Partial match: the matchable portion is allocated and the residual difference is documented, then the record proceeds to Save/Mark Complete. This is the completion-with-residual path underlying the Contradictory terminal state n-015; the residual is not resolved to zero. Whether a residual may be completed, and how it is dispositioned, is More information required; deferred to dm-correction-unresolved.

Exception route: an unidentified item is moved to Reviewed status and left off the zero-difference spine. The route is Observed; its closure and the eligibility boundary that sends an item here rather than to completion are More information required.

Exception route: no confirmable invoice match, so a remittance inquiry is drafted and the item is left Reviewed / On account / Sent email. The route is Observed; the send is left unsent / out of scope, and the closure and eligibility boundary are More information required.

Iterative correction loop: add/adjust/remove invoice rows and re-check Difference. Observed that the iteration occurs; the condition that ends the loop (accept, complete, or route to a disposition) is a confidence threshold that is not established in the frozen source (More information required); deferred to dm-correction-unresolved.
